key_insight: Lock-stepped replicas can share one weight copy; the HBM freed for KV cache is real if the broadcast fabric can match each replica's weight-stream rate.
killer_doubt: Memory-bound decode streams weights at HBM rate (~8 TB/s per GPU); scale-up ingress is ~0.9 TB/s per direction, so per-token latency rises ~9x.
decisive_experiment: Simulate Llama-70B and DeepSeek-V3 serving with weights broadcast at 0.9-3.6 TB/s ingress versus local HBM; report tokens/s/user and the batch needed to recover throughput under a 50 ms TPOT SLO. Software, ~$30k.
prior_art: Cerebras weight streaming (MemoryX plus SwarmX broadcast to many CS-2s, 2021); Phase B N-80 is the same idea (prior knowledge).

key_insight: LPDDR beside the ASIC on an organic substrate gives a few hundred GB/s with no TSVs or CoWoS: real cost relief for mid-tier accelerators.
killer_doubt: A 1024-bit bus needs ~32 x32 LPDDR dies (~50-70 mm2 each), which cannot sit within 3 mm. Apple M-Ultra already ships 1024-bit LPDDR5 at ~800 GB/s.
decisive_experiment: Lay out a 1024-bit LPDDR5X ring on 15 um mSAP; run SI/PI and a cost model against packaged on-substrate LPDDR5X (Grace/SOCAMM style). ~$150k; expect parity, not a step change.
prior_art: Apple M1/M2 Ultra 1024-bit in-package LPDDR5; NVIDIA Grace on-package LPDDR5X; SOCAMM; Phase B N-74 (prior knowledge).

key_insight: A transistor-written storage ring per tier (FG-NAND-style recess) gives semiconductor-channel endurance on 3D-NAND tools. It fills the untried >=16-tier single-etch 2T0C white space.
killer_doubt: Topology: planes are the only per-tier lines, so a continuous outer write channel connects every ring above the target, disturbing up to ~100 tiers per write. Needs AND/NOR-style vertical pillars.
decisive_experiment: Build an 8-tier W/SiO2 stack with one DUV hole, FG-NAND recess, ALD IGZO write shell, segmented metal ring and inner read shell. Measure per-tier write disturb, ring isolation, 85 C retention. University fab, ~$700k.
prior_art: IMECAS 4-tier IGZO 2T0C (VLSI 2026); Huawei vertical CAA IGZO 2T0C; Micron FG 3D NAND recess rings; no coaxial in-hole 2T0C found (via search snippet).

key_insight: Dense-model decode sweeps every weight row each ~10-30 ms, so an inference-only HBM could specify a 16 ms retention window and skip refresh almost for free.
killer_doubt: Above 85 C HBM already refreshes every 32 ms, so the Cs gain is ~2x, not 4x. Sense signal (Cs/C_BL) also sets Cs, so shorter capacitors need new sensing.
decisive_experiment: Capture row-activation traces from vLLM on dense and MoE models at batch 1-256 to find the worst unswept interval. Pair them with retention-tail and sense-margin models of a 2x-shorter capacitor. ~$80k.
prior_art: Smart Refresh (MICRO 2007) skips refresh on recently accessed rows; RANA (ISCA 2018) drops eDRAM refresh when data lifetime is below retention (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Growing every tier's channel in one axial run would bypass stack deposition. Axial-doped nanowires show that tier-free channel formation is conceivable.
killer_doubt: Sixteen n+/p/n+ segments on one wire share n+ nodes: a series string with no storage element. The VLS dopant reservoir grades junctions over ~20 nm, against 25 nm segments.
decisive_experiment: Grow 4-segment n+/p/n+ Si nanowires (Au and Al catalysts) at 20-40 nm diameter. Map junction abruptness by atom probe and the kink rate over 1e6 wires. University CVD, ~$300k.
prior_art: Axial-doped VLS nanowire FETs (Lieber group); Unisantis vertical SGT; atom-probe Au incorporation in VLS Si (Lauhon group) (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Self-assembly can set tier pitch without 100 depositions, and SIS turns polymer lamellae into AlOx stacks below 200 C.
killer_doubt: A 12 nm period leaves a 6 nm channel, a 6 nm insulator and no wordline layer. SIS infiltrates only the polar block, so In2O3 cannot form in the other.
decisive_experiment: Coat a 20-period PS-b-PMMA film, infiltrate TMA/water, and check layer continuity and terrace defects over 1 cm2 by TEM. Measure SIS In2O3 mobility in a test TFT. ~$100k.
prior_art: Argonne sequential infiltration synthesis (Darling, Elam); SIS ZnO/In2O3 films; parallel-lamellar BCP multilayers (prior knowledge).

key_insight: At ~1000 s retention, refresh of a 16 Gb gain-cell array needs only ~0.2-0.7 uW, so retention-mode power is set by the periphery, not the cells.
killer_doubt: A CR2032 (~2.4 kJ) runs 10 uW for ~7 years with no licence. 1 uW from Ni-63 needs ~0.3-1 Ci, against ~15 mCi in licensed ECD sources.
decisive_experiment: Measure the retention-mode power of an IGZO gain-cell macro with gated periphery and negative hold bias. If it is <10 uW per 16 Gb, compare a coin cell with a betavoltaic over 10 years. ~$200k.
prior_art: NVDIMM-N (supercap plus flash backup); Betavolt BV100 Ni-63 cell (~100 uW, 2024); City Labs tritium cells (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Same coaxial in-hole 2T0C as I-10833. A wider-gap channel could cut off-current further, but only if contacts and mobility allow it.
killer_doubt: Even 1e-21 A on a 0.2 fF node with a 0.3 V margin gives ~17 h, not years. Amorphous ALD Ga2O3 is near-insulating (<1 cm2/Vs), with high contact resistance.
decisive_experiment: Fold into I-10833: make planar ALD a-Ga2O3 and IGZO 2T0C cells on one wafer. Compare Ion at 1 V overdrive, contact resistance and 85 C retention. ~$150k.
prior_art: IGZO already shows Ioff <1 aA (Kioxia OCTRAM) and >30,000 s (SJTU IGO 2T0C); Ga2O3 devices are mostly crystalline power FETs (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Names the enabling step: per-tier storage-ring segmentation by selective recess, which floating-gate 3D NAND already does at 100+ tiers. Merge into the I-10833 dossier.
killer_doubt: Reading tier k through a series inner channel needs every other segment forced on, but those gates are floating stored rings; a plane-to-ring coupling below ~0.5 limits the override.
decisive_experiment: TCAD plus a 4-tier test stack. Measure whether plane-to-ring coupling can force unselected read segments on (or switch to AND-type pillars), and the resulting per-tier read window. ~$300k.
prior_art: Micron/Intel floating-gate 3D NAND recessed rings; IMECAS 4-tier IGZO 2T0C (VLSI 2026); Huawei vertical CAA IGZO (prior knowledge).

key_insight: An ON stack plus nitride strip plus confined lateral epitaxy could give single-crystal tiers with no strained Si/SiGe superlattice, avoiding the germanium chokepoint (6-38% of refined Ge).
killer_doubt: Upper tunnels must seed through a ~6 um epitaxial slit trunk, then grow ~0.5-1 um laterally in ~20 nm tunnels, with unproven defect density. imec already grew 120 Si/SiGe bilayers.
decisive_experiment: On 300 mm coupons, make an 8-pair ON stack with support pillars, strip the nitride, and run slit-seeded selective Si epitaxy at 600-700 C. Count defects by TEM/ECCI and measure lateral growth length per tier. ~$400k.
prior_art: Purdue confined epitaxial lateral overgrowth (CELO, 1990s); IBM template-assisted selective epitaxy (TASE, 2015); imec 120 Si/SiGe bilayers (2025) (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Diagonal tier-to-mat interleaving makes a dead tier one erasure per codeword. Tier-yield compounding becomes a ~6-12% parity overhead, which helps every 3D DRAM cell.
killer_doubt: WL-WL and WL-BL shorts load drivers and vertical bitlines shared by 32 tiers, so failures are not tier-confined. Erasure coding fixes 0.99^32 = 72% only if shorts are isolated.
decisive_experiment: Run a Monte Carlo of 3D NAND-style defect maps (opens, shorts, voids) on a rotated tier-to-mat address map with RS(36,32) erasure decoding, and write decoder RTL to get latency and area. Software plus FPGA, ~$100k.
prior_art: Chipkill (IBM 1997); SSD RAIN and die-RAID across NAND planes; no 3D-DRAM tier-orthogonal code found (prior knowledge).

key_insight: At 77 K thermal leakage paths freeze, so barrier tunnelling alone sets retention. Cold computing does lack dense memory.
killer_doubt: Direct tunnelling is temperature-insensitive. Writing in ~10 ns and holding for 1e4 s needs a ~1e12 current ratio; 2 nm SiO2 gives ~1e6-1e8 between ~4 V and ~0.3 V.
decisive_experiment: Make 2 nm-oxide floating-gate capacitors. Measure charge loss at 300 K and 77 K from 1 ms to 1e4 s, and write speed at 3-5 V. Any hours-scale retention would revive the idea. ~$150k.
prior_art: IBM Si-nanocrystal memory with 1-2 nm tunnel oxide (Tiwari 1996); Phase B N-94 (77 K oxide gain cell) is the stronger cold path (prior knowledge).
